versions.changelog: Initial release: add a home dashboard widget that features a daily tag with its media, description, counts, and tagged moments. Shuffle to another tag, open its page or a tagged video, and choose how moments and videos fill the row.
Give every tagged moment and tagged video an equal chance to appear when Tag of the Day shuffles a featured tag's content. The day's selection and remembered shuffles remain stable across reloads.

name: Tag of the Day
description: A home dashboard widget that features one of your tags each day with its media, description, and tagged moments.
author: MidnightRider
